tools.name: find_mentions
tools.description: Find linked and unlinked mentions of a brand across the web via web search results. When a domain is supplied, classifies each mention as linked (on the brand domain) or unlinked (a third-party page — a potential backlink opportunity).

tools.name: find_prospects
tools.description: Find guest-post, resource-page, and roundup link-building prospects for a topic by running classic outreach footprints through web search and merging the results by host.

tools.name: find_competitor_link_sources
tools.description: Approximate the pages linking to a competitor using free web-search signals (domain mentions and brand mentions). De-duplicates by host and excludes the competitor's own domain. Not a complete backlink index — a free, directional starting point for prospecting.

tools.name: verify_page_links
tools.description: Fetch a page and confirm whether it contains a link to the target domain, reporting anchor text and rel attributes (nofollow/sponsored/ugc) and whether the link is dofollow.

tools.name: extract_contact_info
tools.description: Fetch a page and extract contact emails (including de-obfuscated and mailto links) and social media handles (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, GitHub, YouTube).

tools.name: check_page_history
tools.description: Return a Wayback Machine timeline for a URL: total snapshots, first/last archived dates, and a bounded list of snapshot records with direct archive links.

tools.name: generate_outreach_email
tools.description: Draft a short, personalized cold outreach email from a contact + context object using your own LLM key (BYOK). Returns a subject line and body. The API key is request-scoped and is never persisted or logged.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_prospects, extract_contact_info, check_page_history · Private data: extract_contact_info, check_page_history, generate_outreach_email · Public sink: find_prospects, generate_outreach_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_prospects, extract_contact_info, check_page_history · Private data: extract_contact_info, check_page_history, generate_outreach_email · Public sink: find_prospects, generate_outreach_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
